/usr/bin/bash -lc "python3 -B -c 'import pathlib
files = {'\"'\"'cache.py'\"'\"': '\"'\"'from collections import OrderedDict\\n\\nclass TTLCache:\\n    def __init__(self, capacity, clock):\\n        self.capacity = capacity\\n        self.clock = clock\\n        self.entries = OrderedDict()\\n\\n    def _purge(self):\\n        now = self.clock()\\n        for key, (_, deadline) in list(self.entries.items()):\\n            if deadline is not None and now >= deadline:\\n                del self.entries[key]\\n\\n    def set(self, key, value, ttl=None):\\n        self._purge()\\n        self.entries.pop(key, None)\\n        if ttl is not None and ttl <= 0:\\n            return None\\n        deadline = None if ttl is None else self.clock() + ttl\\n        self.entries[key] = (value, deadline)\\n        while len(self.entries) > self.capacity:\\n            self.entries.popitem(last=False)\\n        return None\\n\\n    def get(self, key, default=None):\\n        self._purge()\\n        if key not in self.entries:\\n            return default\\n        self.entries.move_to_end(key)\\n        return self.entries[key][0]\\n\\n    def delete(self, key):\\n        self._purge()\\n        if key not in self.entries:\\n            return False\\n        del self.entries[key]\\n        return True\\n\\n    def __len__(self):\\n        self._purge()\\n        return len(self.entries)\\n'\"'\"'}
for name, content in files.items():
    path = pathlib.Path(name)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(content)

print('\"'\"'OFF48_NATIVE_APPLY_DONE'\"'\"')
'"
